{{Quote|What an odd sensation. It will take some getting used to.|Obi-Wan Kenobi after swallowing the Vocal Emulator|<ref name="Deception">{{TCW|Deception}}</ref>}}
A '''vocal emulator''' was a small recording device used to imitate another being's voice.

==Description==
[[File:VocalEmulator2-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A vocal emulator, with legs extended, in the palm of Mace Windu]]
The vocal emulator was rare piece of technology designed for covert operations. Constructed of an expensive [[scanner]]-resistant composite material, it was mainly used by [[Spy/Legends|spies]] or intelligence agents to alter their voice to match that of a sample subject. Spherical in shape, the device would record a sample of an individual's voice, then analyze such things as pitch, frequency, intonation and inflection to perfectly duplicate the vocal pattern of the subject. Once this was accomplished, tentacle-like limbs would extend from the sphere to help the spy swallow the device. The emulator would affix to the wearer's [[Larynx/Legends|larynx]] and through [[electromyostimulation]] transmitted through the tentacles, the wearer's larynx would be reshaped to duplicate the recorded voice.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
